coordinates.note: Nominatim (OpenStreetMap geocoder) centroid of the institute's office polygon at 11 Academician Lavrentiev Avenue, Akademgorodok, Novosibirsk. Campus-grade only: the VEPP-2M, VEPP-2000 and VEPP-4M rings and their detector halls are not individually located by any source consulted.

name: Budker Institute of Nuclear Physics campus (Akademgorodok, Novosibirsk)
notes: Campus point only; no fetched source locates the collider rings or detector halls.

summary.plain: The campus of the Budker Institute of Nuclear Physics in Akademgorodok, Novosibirsk, Siberia, home of the VEPP electron-positron colliders and their detectors.
summary.technical: BINP SB RAS, 11 Acad. Lavrentieva Pr., Akademgorodok, Novosibirsk. Geocoder (OpenStreetMap/Nominatim) polygon centroid, about 300 m precision; hosts the VEPP-2000 and VEPP-4M colliders and, formerly, VEPP-2M.
